parameters.content:
## 📲 IndiaMART & JustDial Leads → AI Qualification → GoHighLevel + WhatsApp

### How it works
Marketplace leads go cold fast because the same enquiry is often sent to several sellers. This workflow replies first.

Both IndiaMART and JustDial push new enquiries to their own webhook. Each payload is acknowledged right away, then reshaped into one shared lead format, so the rest of the flow doesn't care where it came from. Phone numbers are cleaned to Indian format and leads already handled in earlier runs are skipped.

GPT-4o-mini reads each enquiry against your business profile and sorts it into hot, warm, cold or spam. It also pulls out product, quantity and urgency, and writes a short reply in the buyer's language. Spam stops there. Every genuine lead becomes a GHL contact and opportunity in the matching stage, gets the AI summary as a note, and receives a WhatsApp reply through WATI within seconds. A final tag records whether that message actually went out.

### Setup steps
1. Fill in **Set Business Config** with your business details, GHL location, pipeline and stage IDs, and WATI endpoint.
2. Create an HTTP Header Auth credential with your GHL Private Integration Token and select it on the four GHL nodes.
3. Create a second one with your WATI token for **WATI - Send WhatsApp Reply**.
4. Connect your OpenAI credential to **AI Qualify Lead**.
5. Get a WATI template named `lead_auto_reply` approved, using the variables `name`, `product`, `message` and `business`.
6. Activate the workflow and paste the production webhook URLs into your IndiaMART Push API and JustDial lead push settings.

## 📥 Lead Intake
Two webhooks catch new enquiries from IndiaMART and JustDial. Each one answers instantly so the platform doesn't retry, then maps its own field names into a shared lead format.

## 🧹 Clean & Dedupe
Phone numbers are converted for GHL and WATI, leads with no phone or email are dropped, and anything processed in an earlier run is skipped. Your business context is attached here.

## 🤖 AI Qualification & Spam Filter
GPT-4o-mini scores each lead hot, warm, cold or spam against your business profile and drafts a short WhatsApp reply in the buyer's language. Spam leads exit through the stop branch below.

## 🏗️ GoHighLevel CRM Sync
Genuine leads are upserted, so repeat buyers don't create duplicate contacts. An opportunity lands in the stage matching the AI tier, with the full qualification note attached for sales.

## 💬 WhatsApp Auto-Reply
WATI sends your approved template with the AI-written reply. The contact is then tagged `wa-auto-replied` or `wa-reply-failed`, so failed sends are easy to filter and follow up by phone.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Use HTTP Header Auth (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`) for GHL and WATI, plus the built-in OpenAI credential. Keep IDs in **Set Business Config** and never paste tokens into node fields.

## ⚠️ Error Handler
Catches any failure in the workflow and posts a Slack alert. Wire the error output of critical nodes here to prevent silent failures going unnoticed.
